Statistics of the '''[[Scottish Football League]]''' in season '''1915–16'''. The competition was won by [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]] by eleven points over nearest rival [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]]. Division Two was abandoned due to the outbreak of World War I.
